name: Similipal Tiger Reserve & Biosphere
description: Dense moist-deciduous sal forest ecosystem in Mayurbhanj district, historically prone to intense pre-monsoon dry season wildfires.

name: Bandipur National Park
description: Key tiger reserve in the Western Ghats Nilgiri Biosphere, vulnerable to summer deciduous dry fuel bed fires and bamboo flowering combustion.

name: Jim Corbett Tiger Reserve
description: Sub-Himalayan Shivalik foothills dominated by sal, haldu, and chir pine needle resin beds with elevated high-wind fire spread risk.

name: Gir National Park & Sanctuary
description: The sole habitat of the Asiatic Lion, comprising dry deciduous teak forests, acacia scrub, and dry grass savanna subject to arid heatwaves.
